Fit inner washer, idle gear, collar, primary driven gear, washer, boss, six absorbers, sleeve, washer and spacer.
Ensure washer is not trapped on the spacer step. Fit a new boss nut only after the preparation conflict is resolved.
After correctly torquing the resolved joint75Nm, verify the illustrated washer rotates freely; stake the nut into shaft cutouts without damaging the shaft threads.
